lines.zh: 我踩过湿草，靴子没有响。
lines.en: I cross wet grass; my boots make no sound.

lines.zh: 弩背在身后，弦已经上好了。
lines.en: The crossbow rides my back, already strung.

lines.zh: 我走一整夜，只为找一个棺材。
lines.en: I walk all night to find one coffin.

lines.zh: 木桩在腰上，敲进去要三下。
lines.en: The stake at my belt takes three blows.

lines.zh: 我沿着血迹走，血还没干。
lines.en: I follow the blood trail; it is still wet.

lines.zh: 风从教堂那边来，带着土腥味。
lines.en: Wind from the chapel, smelling of earth.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑会惊动他们。
lines.en: I do not run; running warns them.

lines.zh: 我的靴底钉了铁，踩石板很稳。
lines.en: Iron nails in my soles grip the flagstones.

lines.zh: 白天赶路，夜里才好动手。
lines.en: Travel by day; do the work at night.

lines.zh: 每走过一村，我就记一个名字。
lines.en: Each village I pass, I record one name.

lines.zh: 蒜辫挂在包外，味道冲得很。
lines.en: Garlic braids hang from my pack, sharp in the air.

lines.zh: 我绕开坟地，那里土太松。
lines.en: I skirt the graveyard; the soil there is loose.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，检查弩机的簧片。
lines.en: I crouch and check the crossbow's spring.

lines.zh: 磨刀石在手里转了两圈。
lines.en: The whetstone turns twice in my hand.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，等他们出来。
lines.en: I wait for dark, for them to come out.

lines.zh: 皮袋里还剩半瓶圣水。
lines.en: Half a flask of holy water left in the pouch.

lines.zh: 我把木桩削尖，削得很仔细。
lines.en: I sharpen a stake, taking my time.

lines.zh: 篝火小一点，别招来眼睛。
lines.en: Keep the fire low; do not draw eyes.

lines.zh: 我数着箭，还有十一支。
lines.en: I count bolts: eleven remain.

lines.zh: 手指上的旧疤又痒了。
lines.en: The old scar on my finger itches again.

lines.zh: 我咬着干面包，眼睛没离开林子。
lines.en: I bite dry bread, eyes never leaving the trees.

lines.zh: 那件护符我擦了又擦。
lines.en: I polish the amulet once more.

lines.zh: 我记得每个被我埋掉的人。
lines.en: I remember everyone I have buried.

lines.zh: 夜里安静得不对，太安静了。
lines.en: The night is quiet wrongly. Too quiet.

lines.zh: 我把腰带扣紧一格。
lines.en: I pull my belt one notch tighter.

lines.zh: 我在心里背祷词，只背一半。
lines.en: I recite half a prayer and stop.

lines.zh: 你的牙，露出来给我看看。
lines.en: Show me your teeth.

lines.zh: 你脖子上有咬痕，别动。
lines.en: There are bite marks on your neck. Hold still.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是饿的那种。
lines.en: I know that look. It is hunger.

lines.zh: 你身上没有影子，我数过了。
lines.en: You cast no shadow. I counted.

lines.zh: 你是人，还是披着人皮的东西？
lines.en: Are you a man, or a man's skin?

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的土味了。
lines.en: I smell grave soil on you.

lines.zh: 你伸手的姿势，像要扑过来。
lines.en: You reach like something about to lunge.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我的弩很快。
lines.en: Not so close. My crossbow is quick.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在灯下反光，太亮了。
lines.en: Your eyes catch the lamp. Too bright.

lines.zh: 我见过你这张脸，在通缉令上。
lines.en: I have seen that face on a bounty notice.

lines.zh: 你先说，你从哪座坟里爬出来。
lines.en: You first: which grave did you crawl from?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是等你先眨眼。
lines.en: I hold your gaze, waiting for the first blink.

lines.zh: 你的手别放腰上，我看得见。
lines.en: Keep your hand off your belt. I see it.

lines.zh: 你要是人，就退后三步。
lines.en: If you are human, back away three steps.

lines.zh: 我把十字架举到你眼前，认得吗？
lines.en: I hold the cross up before your eyes. Recognize it?

lines.zh: 你笑起来的时候，牙太齐了。
lines.en: Your teeth are too neat when you smile.

lines.zh: 别用那种口气，我们不同路。
lines.en: Don't take that tone. We walk different roads.

lines.zh: 我数你眨眼的次数，一次也没有。
lines.en: I counted your blinks. Not one.

lines.zh: 皮外伤，包一下就好。
lines.en: A scratch. A bandage will do.

lines.zh: 你的劲够大，可惜慢半拍。
lines.en: Your strength is real, but you are half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我吐了口血，站得更稳。
lines.en: I spit blood and stand firmer.

lines.zh: 这不算什么，我挨过更重的。
lines.en: This is nothing; I have taken worse.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，手是热的。
lines.en: I press the wound; my hand comes away warm.

lines.zh: 疼让我清醒，正好。
lines.en: Pain sharpens me. Good.

lines.zh: 骨头没断，还能拉弦。
lines.en: No bone broken; I can still draw.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，那我也记住你了。
lines.en: You struck me. Now I remember you.

lines.zh: 我不后退，退一步它就跑了。
lines.en: I do not retreat; one step and it escapes.

lines.zh: 血从袖子里往下滴，我不管。
lines.en: Blood drips from my sleeve. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 钱？我追的东西不用钱买。
lines.en: Coin? What I hunt is not bought.

lines.zh: 你想用金币换我一条命？
lines.en: You would trade gold for my life?

lines.zh: 酒我不喝，喝了手会抖。
lines.en: No drink. It makes my hands shake.

lines.zh: 你的护符是假的，我一眼看得出。
lines.en: Your amulet is false. I can tell at a glance.

lines.zh: 别献东西，献上你的名字。
lines.en: Do not offer goods. Offer your name.

lines.zh: 我收报酬，但只收吸血鬼的头。
lines.en: I take payment, but only vampire heads.

lines.zh: 把面包拿开，我现在不饿。
lines.en: Put the bread away. I am not hungry now.

lines.zh: 一袋银币换不来我的弩。
lines.en: A bag of silver will not buy my crossbow.

lines.zh: 你想贿赂我，说明你心里有鬼。
lines.en: Bribing me means you have something to hide.

lines.zh: 我要的不是这些，是那口棺材的钥匙。
lines.en: What I want is the key to that coffin.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我的弩已经上弦。
lines.en: Out of the way; my crossbow is loaded.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞肩膀，我们都不让。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 我侧身过去，斗篷扫到你。
lines.en: I pass sideways; my cloak brushes you.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我记你一笔。
lines.en: One shove from you, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我身上全是铁，撞着会疼。
lines.en: I am all iron. Bumping me hurts.

lines.zh: 让开，我要赶在天亮前回去。
lines.en: Move; I must be back before dawn.

lines.zh: 我们挤在门口，谁都进不去。
lines.en: We jam the doorway; neither enters.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，不是怕你。
lines.en: I stepped back. Not from fear.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的木桩了，抬脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my stake. Lift your foot.

lines.zh: 撞完各走各的，别回头。
lines.en: We collide, part, and do not look back.

lines.zh: 我没空谈这个，坟里还有人。
lines.en: No time for that; someone is still in a grave.

lines.zh: 猎人不成家，成家就会分心。
lines.en: Hunters do not marry; it splits the mind.

lines.zh: 我的伴儿死在十年前那一夜。
lines.en: My partner died that night, ten years ago.

lines.zh: 你找别人吧，我的床是给木桩留的。
lines.en: Find another. My bed is kept for stakes.

lines.zh: 这行当传不下去，我也不想传。
lines.en: This trade cannot be passed on. I will not try.

lines.zh: 我手上的茧比誓言硬。
lines.en: The calluses on my hands are harder than vows.

lines.zh: 结婚要请神父，我只请过掘墓人。
lines.en: Weddings need a priest; I have only called gravediggers.

lines.zh: 我睡得浅，身边有人会惊醒。
lines.en: I sleep light; another beside me would wake me.

lines.zh: 别问这个，问就是没有。
lines.en: Do not ask. The answer is no.

lines.zh: 我的心是冷的，装在袋子里。
lines.en: My heart is cold — it rides in a pouch.

lines.zh: 地上的弩箭我捡，能再用一次。
lines.en: I pick up spent bolts; they work once more.

lines.zh: 那枚戒指我收了，死人的东西。
lines.en: I take the ring. It belonged to the dead.

lines.zh: 腰带还能用，扣子没坏。
lines.en: The belt still serves; the buckle holds.

lines.zh: 我不捡钱，钱会招人。
lines.en: I leave the coin. Money draws people.

lines.zh: 我把尸体上的护符摘下来。
lines.en: I take the amulet off the body.

lines.zh: 人心要单独包好，不能压坏。
lines.en: A human heart must be wrapped alone, not crushed.

lines.zh: 碎布条我留着，包扎用得上。
lines.en: I keep the rag strips for bandages.

lines.zh: 那支箭断了，我扔回去。
lines.en: That bolt is broken. I toss it back.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的蒜，还能驱一次。
lines.en: I pick up the dropped garlic; one more warding.

lines.zh: 东西不是我的，我不拿。
lines.en: What belongs to others, I leave where it lies.

lines.zh: 有东西在屋脊上走，脚步太轻。
lines.en: Something walks the roof. Its steps are too light.

lines.zh: 那股味道从地窖口飘上来。
lines.en: That smell rises from the cellar door.

lines.zh: 我看见一双红眼睛贴在窗上。
lines.en: I see red eyes pressed to the window.

lines.zh: 它动了，我先把弩抬起来。
lines.en: It moved. I raise the crossbow first.

lines.zh: 那个影子躲进树后，太慢了。
lines.en: The shape hides behind a tree. Too slow.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在数数，数到三。
lines.en: I hear counting. It reaches three.

lines.zh: 血味新鲜，就在这片林子里。
lines.en: The blood is fresh, here in these trees.

lines.zh: 我锁定最高的那个，首领先死。
lines.en: I mark the tallest. Kill the leader first.

lines.zh: 它没影子，我不用再犹豫。
lines.en: It casts no shadow. No more doubt.

lines.zh: 猎物回头看我了，正好。
lines.en: The quarry looks back. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把木桩从腰上抽出来。
lines.en: I draw the stake from my belt.

lines.zh: 目标在动，我的呼吸却慢下来。
lines.en: The target moves; my breathing slows.

lines.zh: 它以为夜里是它的，错了。
lines.en: It thinks the night is its own. Wrong.

lines.zh: 我看见它的牙，够了。
lines.en: I see its teeth. That is enough.

lines.zh: 林子边的影子跳得太直，不像人。
lines.en: The shadow at the treeline hops too straight to be a person.

lines.zh: 我的护符在发烫，附近有东西。
lines.en: My amulet is warm. Something is near.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，一步一寸。
lines.en: I move along the wall, an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 弩举到肩，弦绷着。
lines.en: The crossbow comes to my shoulder, string taut.

lines.zh: 它嗅空气，我在下风口。
lines.en: It sniffs the air; I stand downwind.

lines.zh: 再近三步，我就能打中眼睛。
lines.en: Three steps closer and I can hit the eye.

lines.zh: 我等它转身，等它露出后背。
lines.en: I wait for it to turn, to show its back.

lines.zh: 手指搭在扳机上，没有抖。
lines.en: My finger rests on the trigger, steady.

lines.zh: 影子拉长了，它要来了。
lines.en: The shadow lengthens. It comes.

lines.zh: 它在屋顶停住，我也停住。
lines.en: It halts on the roof. I halt too.

lines.zh: 我数自己的呼吸，压到最慢。
lines.en: I count my breaths and slow them down.

lines.zh: 它开始绕圈，想从背后过来。
lines.en: It circles, meaning to come from behind.

lines.zh: 我先封住那扇门。
lines.en: I block that door first.

lines.zh: 圣水瓶在我左手，随时能砸。
lines.en: Holy water in my left hand, ready to throw.

lines.zh: 它听见我的心跳了吗？不会。
lines.en: Can it hear my heart? It cannot.

lines.zh: 再等一等，好的猎人不急。
lines.en: Wait a little. A good hunter is patient.

lines.zh: 我蹲进灌木，只露弩尖。
lines.en: I crouch into the brush, showing only the crossbow tip.

lines.zh: 风向变了，我换到它背后。
lines.en: The wind shifted. I move behind it.

lines.zh: 它爬墙，我就退到巷口等。
lines.en: It climbs the wall, so I fall back to the alley mouth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抽出木桩，不出声。
lines.en: I draw the stake slowly, making no sound.

lines.zh: 它在屋檐上，我的准星跟着。
lines.en: It's on the eaves. My sights follow.

lines.zh: 我留一条退路，猎人也怕被围。
lines.en: I keep a line of retreat. Even hunters fear being surrounded.

lines.zh: 弩响之前，我已经扑上去。
lines.en: Before the bolt flies, I am already on it.

lines.zh: 木桩对准心口，一锤下去。
lines.en: The stake finds the heart; the mallet falls.

lines.zh: 我用弩托砸它的脸。
lines.en: I smash its face with the crossbow's stock.

lines.zh: 近身了，弩没用，换刀。
lines.en: Too close for the bow. I draw the knife.

lines.zh: 我一手按住它，一手找心脏。
lines.en: One hand pins it; the other finds the heart.

lines.zh: 它咬我手臂，我咬着牙不松。
lines.en: It bites my arm; I grit my teeth and hold.

lines.zh: 圣水泼上去，它皮在冒烟。
lines.en: Holy water splashes; its skin smokes.

lines.zh: 我膝盖顶它肚子，把它压下去。
lines.en: My knee drives into its gut, pressing it down.

lines.zh: 这一刀是给我妹妹的。
lines.en: This cut is for my sister.

lines.zh: 它挣了一下，我补了第二下。
lines.en: It struggles once; I strike a second time.

lines.zh: 我把它的头按进土里。
lines.en: I press its head into the dirt.

lines.zh: 血溅到脸上，我不擦。
lines.en: Blood on my face. I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 手别抖，最后一锤要准。
lines.en: Steady. The last blow must be exact.

lines.zh: 打完我坐下了，腿在抖。
lines.en: When it ends I sit down. My legs shake.

lines.zh: 木桩尖顶进肋骨，我压下去。
lines.en: I drive the stake between its ribs and lean in.

lines.zh: 它抓我的肩，我改用肘。
lines.en: It claws my shoulder, so I switch to my elbow.

lines.zh: 弩弦断了，我抡起弩身。
lines.en: The string snapped. I swing the stock instead.

lines.zh: 我把它按在墙上，一刀到底。
lines.en: I pin it to the wall and drive the blade home.

lines.zh: 我从村口进来，弩已经上弦。
lines.en: I enter at the village gate, crossbow loaded.

lines.zh: 有人在夜里敲我的门，说林子里有东西。
lines.en: Someone knocked at night: something in the woods.

lines.zh: 我睡在马上，醒来就到了这里。
lines.en: I slept in the saddle and woke here.

lines.zh: 我带着三根木桩，一根圣水。
lines.en: I carry three stakes and one flask of holy water.

lines.zh: 通缉令贴在酒馆墙上，我撕了下来。
lines.en: The notice was on the tavern wall. I tore it down.

lines.zh: 我的靴子还沾着上一个村的泥。
lines.en: My boots still hold the last village's mud.

lines.zh: 天刚擦黑，我就站在这里了。
lines.en: Dusk had barely fallen when I took this spot.

lines.zh: 有人在哭，我循着哭声来的。
lines.en: Someone was weeping. I followed the sound.

lines.zh: 护符是母亲给的，我一直戴着。
lines.en: The amulet was my mother's. I never took it off.

lines.zh: 我推开门，屋里没有活人。
lines.en: I pushed the door; no one inside was alive.

lines.zh: 路上的血还没干，我追到这儿。
lines.en: The blood on the road was wet. I followed it here.

lines.zh: 我不敲门，我踹门。
lines.en: I do not knock. I kick.

lines.zh: 这次报酬是四枚银币，够用了。
lines.en: Four silver this time. Enough.

lines.zh: 我把斗篷抖开，抖下一层灰。
lines.en: I shake out my cloak and a layer of dust falls.

lines.zh: 我沿着血迹走了一夜到这里。
lines.en: I followed the blood trail all night to get here.

lines.zh: 天亮前我必须找到它。
lines.en: I have to find it before dawn.

lines.zh: 我把圣水挂在腰上，先看四周。
lines.en: I hang the holy water at my hip and look around first.

lines.zh: 门没锁，我就知道里面出事了。
lines.en: The door was unlocked, so I knew something went wrong inside.

lines.zh: 火燎了斗篷，我在地上滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak; I roll once on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶摔下来，肋下有点闷。
lines.en: I fall from the roof; something dull aches below my ribs.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我扒着石头往上。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I claw up the stone.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响，弩还在手里。
lines.en: The blast rings in my ears; the crossbow stays in my hand.

lines.zh: 有人从背后射我，箭卡在甲缝里。
lines.en: Someone shot my back; the bolt is wedged in my mail.

lines.zh: 那道光把我的护符烧黑了。
lines.en: That light scorched my amulet black.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，手开始发抖。
lines.en: Two days without food, and my hands start shaking.

lines.zh: 雷落在三步外，我的牙都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning lands three steps away; my teeth go numb.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，木桩还攥在手里。
lines.en: I fall, still gripping the stake.
